title.en: Janai Kata no Hakushaku Reijou - Hitochigai de Kyuukonsareta no de Hadan ni shite Sashiagemasu
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Ryakudatsusareta no de, Koushaku-ke na Kouhai to Gisou Kon'yaku shitara Naze ka Dekiaisareteimasu.
Amai Okashi no Nochi wa Amai Dekiai wo - Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa Henkyou Haku Shisoku ni Dekiaisareru
Dokushin Shugi no Reijou wa, Koushaku-sama no Dekiai kara Nogaretai
Watashi wo Dekiaishi Sugiru Danna-sama wa Konya mo Furete Kuremasen
Fuguu no Reijou wa Kitai no Hikari Mahoutsukai ni Misomerare Hanahiraku
Ouhi ni Naru Yotei Deshita ga, Nise Seijo no Omei wo Kiserareta no de Toubou Shitara, Koutaishi ni Dekiai Saremashita. Sochira mo Douzo Oshiawase ni
Furin Aite ga Mama Haha Datta no de Rien wo Keikaku Itashimasu
Hanayome Shuugyou wo Yametakute, Reitetsu Koushaku no 13-banme no Konyakusha ni narimasu
"Akage no Yakutatazu" to Kubi ni natta Maryokunashi no Majo desu ga, "Yakusou no Chishiki ga Hanpanai!" to Ouritsu Kenkyuujo ni Soku Saiyou Saremashita.
Kyou kara Anata no Goei desu ~Outaishi Denka no Juunenme no Toai~
Itsuwari no Inaka Reijou, Osananajimi no Ouji-sama wo Kouryaku-chuu
Kokoro wo Tozashita Koushaku Kakka to Konyaku Shita Hazu na no ni, Naze ka Taisetsu ni Sasete Shimattemasu!
